result.description: Raga Motors Pty Ltd T/A Goodyear Springwood  The Motor Mechanic is responsible for diagnosing, servicing, testing and repairing petrol engines and mechanical components of light motor vehicles. The role requires strong technical knowledge, problem solving ability and attention to detail to ensure vehicles operate safely, efficiently and reliably.   Benefits  Working in a mechanical shop as a motor mechanic offers several valuable benefits. It helps develop hands-on skills in engine repair, diagnostics, and the use of specialized tools. The role is in high demand, providing strong job security and steady income, often with opportunities for overtime. It also opens pathways to career advancement, including positions like supervisor or even owning a workshop. Working in this environment allows you to earn trade certifications and gain practical experience recognized in various industries. Additionally, it enhances problem-solving abilities, keeps you physically active, and provides personal satisfaction from fixing vehicles and helping customers.      Task & responsibilities   Detect and diagnose mechanical faults in engines and related vehicle components using appropriate testing and diagnostic equipment.  Dismantle and remove assembled engines, transmissions, steering systems, and other vehicle parts.  Inspect and evaluate the condition of disassembled components.  Identify faulty parts and perform necessary repairs or replacements.  Reassemble mechanical components following successful repairs.  Interpret and follow service manual instructions during repair or replacement procedures.  Perform routine maintenance services such as lubrication, engine tune-ups, and oil changes.  Ensure vehicles operate efficiently and meet environmental regulations through scheduled maintenance.  Rebuild engines and components after completing repair work.  Test and adjust repaired parts to confirm proper functionality and performance.  Utilize computerized diagnostic tools to assess and test vehicle systems.  Conduct vehicle inspections for roadworthiness and issue certificates when applicable.  Provide detailed assessments of additional work required to meet roadworthiness standards.  Respond to roadside assistance calls and perform on-site vehicle repairs when necessary.       Qualification & experience   AQF Certificate III in Automotive Mechanical Technology (or equivalent)   Minimum one year experience in the relevant field.    Skills    Up-to-date trade knowledge.  Full-time work rights and immediate availability.  Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing various vehicle systems.  Excellent diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.  Ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues.  Strong attention to detail and work ethic.  Good understanding of safety protocols and compliance with industry standards.    Salary:     $80,000.00 + Super    Full Time:     38 hours per week   About Company     Raga Motors Pty Ltd trading as Goodyear Autocare Springwood is a trusted automotive service provider based in Slacks Creek, QLD. The business offers tyres, wheel alignments, brakes, batteries, steering and suspension repairs, roadworthy inspections, logbook servicing and general mechanical repairs for cars, commercial vehicles, light trucks and 4WDs, supported by experienced technicians and a strong focus on quality customer service.    Goodyear has been a part of Australian roads since 1915, when we established our first distribution company in Sydney. The company quickly expanded, opening a Melbourne office and building strong distribution networks across Adelaide, Brisbane, Perth, and New Zealand.    In 1989, we introduced Goodyear’s franchised retail model, offering multi-brand tyre and auto services. This evolved in 2006 into Goodyear Autocare    ?   - a new, specialised network focused on providing Australian drivers across the country with expert advice and trusted one-stop-shop tyre and automotive care.    With over 110 years on Australian roads, Goodyear remains a name generations have trusted to keep them moving.             Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-80000   Job Publish:  13-07-2026   Job Expire:  12-08-2026  Apply on:  Motor Mechanic Job here!    This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

Let your skills & strength shine Admin / HR / WHSE 
Bowhill Engineering is growing, and we're looking for capable, organised and proactive people to join our team to support Admin, HR & WHSE. 
You may come from an Administration background, have experience in Human Resources, be passionate about Workplace Health & Safety, or bring a combination of all three. What matters most is your ability to keep things organised, support our people, and help our business operate efficiently. 
We have opportunities across Administration, HR and WHSE functions, with responsibilities tailored to suit the skills and experience of the successful applicants. 
Whether you're looking to broaden your career, develop new skills, or bring your existing expertise into a supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you. 

About the Role 
In any of these roles, you'll become an important part of our team, providing administrative and operational support across a range of business functions. 

Depending on your experience and interests, your responsibilities may include: 
Administration Support 
-Reception and general office administration
-Calendar and appointment coordination
-Document preparation and record management
*Support the business wholistically with administration requirements
-Plan, prep and coordinate employee & visitor engagement activities & events 

Human Resources Support 
-Payroll processing assistance and backup
-Recruitment and onboarding coordination
-Employee records administration
-Performance appraisal coordination
-Employee recognition and wellbeing initiatives 

WHSE Support 
-Maintaining safety and compliance records
-Coordinating training and inductions
-Supporting audits, inspections and corrective actions
-Assisting with incident reporting and investigations
-Return-to-work and rehabilitation administration 
Full training and support will be provided, and the roles can evolve based on the successful candidate's strengths and career aspirations. 

What We're Looking For 
You don't need experience in all areas. We're interested in people who: 
? Are highly organised and detail-oriented 
? Enjoy helping others and supporting teams 
? Communicate professionally and confidently 
? Take initiative and ownership of their work 
? Can manage multiple priorities effectively 
? Have strong computer and administrative skills 
? Bring a positive, solutions-focused attitude 

Experience That Would Be Valuable 
-Business Administration
-Human Resources
-Payroll or Recruitment
-WHSE, Compliance or Training Administration
-Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) 

Relevant qualifications or a willingness to undertake further training will be highly regarded. 

Why Join Bowhill Engineering? 
At Bowhill Engineering, we're proud of the culture we've built. We're a team that values people, growth, accountability and continuous improvement. 

Employee Benefits Include: 
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
-Health & Wellbeing Support
-Reward & Recognition Programs
-Social Events & Team Activities
-Career Development & Training Opportunities
-Modern Workplace Facilities 
-Supportive Team Environment 

What You'll Love 
-Variety and flexibility in your role
-Opportunities to learn and develop new skills
-Making a genuine impact across the business
-Working with a team that values your contribution 

Ready to Apply? 
If you're an organised, motivated person looking for a rewarding role where you can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.
